subject: general
question: The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee recommended in 1957 for the establishment of a ____ Panchayati Raj System in India.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Three-tier__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Balwant Rai Mehta Committee **was appointed to examine the working of the community development program and the national extension service.
 
• Balwant Rai Mehta Committee was appointed in 1957.
 
• Balwant Rai Mehta was the chairman of this committee.
 
• The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee recommended establishing a three-tier Panchayati Raj structure.
 
• The Balwant Rai Mehta committee suggested that the structure of the Panchayati Raj should consist of the village, the block, and the district level.
 
 
• Gram Panchayat at the village level.
 
• Panchayat Samiti at the block level.
 
• Zila Parishad at the district level.
 
 
 
• The National Development Council approved the committee's recommendations in 1958.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other committees related to Panchayati raj:
 
• Ashok Mehta Committee:
 
 
• In December 1977, the Janata Government appointed a committee on Panchayati raj institutions under the chairmanship of Ashok Mehta.
 
• It submitted its report in August 1978 and made 132 recommendations to revive and strengthen the declining Panchayati raj system in the country.
 
• Due to the collapse of the Janata Government before the completion of its term, no action could be taken on the recommendations of the Ashok Mehta committee at the central level.
 
• However, the three states of Karnataka, West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh took steps to revitalise the Panchayati raj, keeping in view some of the recommendations of the Ashok Mehta Committee.
 
 
 
• L. M. Singhvi Committee-
 
 
• In 1986, the Rajiv Gandhi government appointed a committee to prepare a concept paper on ‘Revitalisation of Panchayati Raj Institutions for Democracy and Development’ under the chairmanship of L M Singhvi.
 
 
 
• G. V. K. Rao Committee:
 
 
• The Committee to review the existing Administrative Arrangements for Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation Programmes under the chairmanship of G.V.K. Rao was appointed by the Planning Commission in 1985.
